Minimum-viable board.yaml (v2).description: Smallest board.yaml (schema v2) with per-core `cores:` block. Keys are canonical core IDs from the SoM preset's topology (e.g. a55_cluster, m33_sm, m55_hp, m55_he).

Heterogeneous multi-core board.yaml (v2).description: Heterogeneous dual-core board.yaml (schema v2): A-cluster (Yocto) + M-class (Zephyr) with RPMsg IPC carve-out.

Carrier populated-override block.description: Override the carrier preset's populated defaults (per-chip true/false).

Per-core inference backend block (v2).description: Inference backend declared per-core inside the cores: block (schema v2). Use the canonical core ID that runs inference (e.g. m55_hp, m55_he).

Per-core IoT feature toggles (v2).description: IoT feature toggles declared per-core inside the cores: block (schema v2).

Per-core libraries enable list (v2).description: Libraries declared per-core inside the cores: block (schema v2).

IPC carve-out block (v2).description: Cross-core IPC shared-memory carve-out (schema v2). Addresses are computed deterministically by the orchestrator from the SoM preset's memory_map.
